description: This file contains the implementation of the Register page model handling user registration in the 'Identity' area of an ASP.NET Core Razor Pages application. It manages user input, creates new user accounts, generates email confirmation tokens, and triggers email verification.

classes.name: RegisterModel
classes.description: PageModel class handling user registration functionalities, including account creation, email confirmation, and sign-in.

classes.name: InputModel
classes.description: Data transfer object representing user input fields: Email, Password, ConfirmPassword for registration.

methods.name: OnGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests, initializes return URL for the registration page.

methods.name: OnPostAsync
methods.description: Handles POST requests for user registration, manages user creation, email verification, and sign-in.
